reviewedMappings.2014-3-33:0: Original table has felsic viscosity ㄱ, mafic viscosity ㄴ, felsic explosivity ㄷ, mafic explosivity ㄹ. Silica raises viscosity; retained bubbles explain generally stronger explosive behavior. This is a typical comparison, not an absolute rule. Source lines 19–22 support gas retention, explosive fragmentation and basaltic exceptions.
